## Perspective Audit Summary

**Component/artifact reviewed:** PodcastPlayer (Fixture: Podcast Player Without Transcripts)  
**Perspectives escalated for deep review:** Auditory Access, Screen Reader & Semantic Structure  
**Perspectives at LOW (not reviewed):** Magnification & Reflow, Environmental Contrast, Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity, Keyboard & Motor Access, Cognitive & Neurodivergent

---

### Findings by Severity

| Severity | Count |
|---|---|
| CRITICAL | 2 |
| MAJOR | 1 |
| MINOR | 0 |
| ENHANCEMENT | 0 |

---

### Perspectives That Passed

None — both escalated perspectives have findings.

---

### Findings With Details

#### Finding 1: No Captions or Transcripts for Audio Content  
**WCAG:** 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded), 1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)  
**Perspective:** Auditory Access  
**Severity:** CRITICAL  
**Route to:** Content Author (secondary: Front-End Dev)  
**Evidence:** `<audio ref={audioRef} src={currentEpisode ? `/audio/${currentEpisode.id}.mp3` : undefined} />` — no `<track kind="captions">` element present; no transcript link or section in markup. Expected behavior states transcripts should be available but none are implemented.  
**Fix:** Add `<track kind="captions" src="..." default>` to the audio element for each episode, and provide a visible transcript link/section below the player per episode.

---

#### Finding 2: No Transcript Link or Section Provided Per Episode  
**WCAG:** 1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)  
**Perspective:** Auditory Access  
**Severity:** CRITICAL  
**Route to:** Content Author (secondary: Front-End Dev)  
**Evidence:** No transcript markup or link exists anywhere in the component for any episode. Expected behavior explicitly calls for transcripts but they are absent from implementation.  
**Fix:** Implement a transcript section or link adjacent to each episode entry and/or below the player bar, linking to full text content of spoken material.

---

#### Finding 3: Speed Control Change Not Announced to Screen Readers  
**WCAG:** 4.1.3 Status Messages  
**Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure  
**Severity:** MAJOR  
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: UX Design)  
**Evidence:** `<select id="speed-select" ... aria-label="Playback speed">` — changing the value updates `playbackRate` but does not trigger any announcement via `aria-live`. Expected behavior requires announcing newly selected speed. No live region is used.  
**Fix:** Add an `aria-live="polite"` container that announces the new playback rate when changed, e.g., “Playback speed set to 1.5x”.

---

### Open Questions Requiring Human Verification

- [ ] **Caption accuracy and timing** — Cannot be verified from source; requires content author review of actual caption files once added.  
- [ ] **Transcript completeness and speaker identification** — Requires human verification that transcripts match spoken content exactly, including speaker labels.  
- [ ] **Audio description coverage (if applicable)** — If episodes contain important non-speech audio information, descriptions must be verified by a content author.

---

### Recommended Next Step

**BLOCK** — Two CRITICAL findings related to missing captions and transcripts prevent access for deaf/hard-of-hearing users. Do not ship until `<track kind="captions">` elements are added with valid sources, and transcript sections/links are implemented per episode. Address the MAJOR finding (speed announcement) before final release as well.
